task_instruction: Review IT access request batch AR-29 for employee E-443 using the available sources. Determine which permissions should be approved, which should be denied and why, the overall risk level of this request, what additional approvals are required before any approved permissions can be granted, any policy exceptions that would be needed, which requests in the batch should be excluded from this review, and any security risk flags. Apply the role permission matrix, data access policy, and access history when evaluating each request. Return only a JSON object with these fields: approved_permissions, denied_permissions, risk_level, required_approvals, policy_exceptions_needed, excluded_requests, risk_flags. approved_permissions must be an array of short snake_case labels for resources and permission levels that can be granted under current policy. denied_permissions must be an array of short snake_case labels for resources and permission levels that cannot be granted. risk_level must be a short lowercase string: low, medium, or high. required_approvals must be an array of short snake_case labels for approver roles needed before any approved permissions are activated. policy_exceptions_needed must be an array of short snake_case labels for exceptions that would be required to approve any currently denied item (leave empty if no exceptions could override a denial). excluded_requests must be an array of short snake_case labels for requests in the batch that belong to other batches or other employees and are not part of AR-29. risk_flags must be an array of short snake_case labels for security risks identified. Do not include explanation outside the JSON.

# Data Access and Security Policy

## Contractor Access Restrictions

Contractors are treated as external parties and may only access systems listed
as explicitly permitted for the contractor role in the role permission matrix.
Any resource showing "none" in the matrix requires a signed Data Access Exception
(DAE) approved by the Security Lead and the department head.

## PII Access

Customer PII databases are classified as Restricted. Access requires:
1. A business justification approved by the department head
2. Security Lead sign-off
3. No prior data handling violations on record

QA and testing must use anonymized or synthetic data sets, not production PII,
unless a specific production data exception is approved by the Privacy Officer.

## Delete Permissions

Delete-level access to any production database is never granted to contractors
or analysts. This applies regardless of business justification.

## Audit Log Access

Internal audit logs are classified as Confidential. Contractor role access level
is "none" per the role matrix. Debugging access for contractors must be routed
through a supervised session with an on-staff engineer.

## Deployment Pipeline

Write access to the deployment pipeline requires the engineer role or above.
Contractor role does not include deployment write access by default.

correct_solution_process: Only R5 (usage_reports read) is in the contractor role matrix as allowed, and it does not require additional approval. R1 (PII read): contractor role = none, plus prior PII handling violation makes this denied. R2 (audit logs read): contractor role = none, and contractor debugging access should use a supervised session instead of direct access, so it is denied. R3 (deployment write): contractor role = none and write access requires engineer role or above, so it is denied. R4 (PII delete): contractor role = none AND policy states delete access to production databases is never granted to contractors, so it is denied. Risk level is high because the request combines a prior PII violation, multiple high-sensitivity denied requests, production PII access, and delete access. required_approvals is empty because the only approved item is R5, which needs no extra approver before activation. policy_exceptions_needed is empty because the currently denied items are blocked by role restrictions, prior violation, supervised-session routing, or non-overridable delete restriction rather than a simple approvable exception. N1 (AR-28, E-771) and N2 (AR-30, E-551) are excluded from AR-29 review.
